Description

Fiendish wings, sharp claws, and a whipping scorpion-like tail lash behind this diminutive, red-skinned nuisance.

Defense

AC 16, touch 15, flat-footed 12 (+3 dex, +1 dodge, +1 natural, +1 size)

hp 19 [33] (3d10+3); Fast Healing 2

mp 3

Fort +2, Ref +6, Will +5

Immune Fire, Poison; Resist Ice 10, Wind 5

Offense

Speed 20 ft., Fly 50 ft. (good)

Melee 2 Claws +7 (1d4), Sting +7 (1d4 plus poison)

Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

Special Attacks Dancehall Daze

Spells Known (SC CL 3rd; Concentration +5)

1st (DC 13) - blind, fire, sleep

Statistics

Str 10, Dex 17, Con 12, Int 13, Wis 14, Cha 14

Base Atk +3; CMB +2; CMD 16

Feats Dodge, Weapon Finesse

Skills Acrobatics +9, Bluff +8, Fly +21, Knowledge (arcana, planes) +7, Perception +7, Spellcraft +7, Stealth +9

Languages Common, Infernal

Sting—injury; save Fort DC 14; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d2 Dex; cure 1 save. The save DC is Constitution-based, and includes a +2 racial bonus.

effect: Creature injured by sting. Once per round for 6 rounds: record [[1d2]] Dexterity damage, not HP. Cure: one successful save.
Resolve after a successful Sting attack.

description.value: Once per day, the imp devil may do a jaunty jig enticing others nearby to dance uncontrollably. All enemies within a 20-foot radius of the imp devil must make a Will save (DC 13) or be inflicted with Daze status for 1 round. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 17).

effect: Enemies only. On a failed save: Daze for one round.

description.value: Imp devils are just plain dark creatures, and they tend to blend into dark surroundings easier. In darkness and low-light, imp devils gain a +4 circumstance bonus to Stealth.
